note: BH-9423: comma-separated path patterns whose secret-shaped locations are test data, read by bin/lib/watchman-allow.sh. A pattern ending in / matches a whole path segment anywhere (tests/ matches pkg/tests/x.js, not contests/x.js); a pattern starting with *. matches the file suffix; any other pattern is one exact path. A pattern with a character outside [A-Za-z0-9_./*-] is dropped with one warn line. Empty (or no valid pattern) = this default list. An allowlisted location stays in the leak cache but makes no beat, no baseline count, no finding and no count in live_unrotated_secrets.
